Bridal Gold Sets

Complete bridal jewelry sets for your special day. Traditional Pakistani designs with modern elegance.

Bridal Gold Sets

Your wedding day deserves gold that matches the occasion. Whether you’re planning your dulhan jewellery set, walima jewellery, or barat gold jewellery, our Traditional Pakistani Bridal Set features intricate filigree work, embedded pearlsand precious gemstones across a complete 7-piece bridal gold set necklace, an earrings design for your wedding, tikka, bridal bangles and more, handcrafted in-house.

Every bridal order from a complete gold set design to a gold engagement ring or wedding ring design to match is quoted individually based on weight, design intricacy and the karat you choose, so you get an honest, transparent price for a set that’s truly yours. Ask us in-store about how much gold is typically used for a bridal set at your budget.

  • Complete sets: necklace, earrings, tikka, bangles and more
  • 24K pure gold with traditional filigree, pearl and gemstone work
  • 100% handcrafted by our in-house goldsmiths
  • Custom quote based on your design and budget

Questions

Bridal Gold Sets FAQs

How far in advance should I order a bridal set?

We recommend visiting or messaging us as early as possible before the wedding date to allow time for design and crafting.

Can the bridal set be customized?

Yes every bridal set can be adjusted in weight, stone work and piece count to match your budget and preference.

Do you offer matching sets for the groom's family?

Yes, ask us about matching or complementary pieces when you place your bridal order.
